outbox_oldest_pending_age_s.alert: Dispatch is stalled: pending outbox rows are ageing. Check the beat service, the dispatcher task and broker reachability.

outbox_dead.alert: Dead-lettered dispatch rows need replay. Inspect last_error, fix the cause, then reset status to pending.

leases_expired.alert: Worker leases are expiring. Check worker health, Redis reachability and task time limits.

jobs_running_without_lease.alert: Running jobs have no lease: the reconciler cleared them but nothing reclaimed them. Check the dispatcher.

partial_jobs_24h.alert: Jobs are completing partially. Inspect gap_reason for Last9 API failures or skipped ID batches.

completed_without_pointer_24h.alert: Jobs completed without a publication pointer. Treat as artifact drift; check runner logs.

celery_queue_depth.alert: Broker backlog. Check worker count/health and Redis memory; scale workers or reduce churn.

beat_heartbeat_age_s.alert: No scheduler tick. Check the beat service, its guard lock and Redis reachability.

beat_lock.alert: No beat lock exists, so no scheduler owns the clock. Start exactly one beat instance.

worker_online.alert: No worker heartbeat. Check worker containers and their database/Redis connectivity.
